parameters.query:
WITH due AS (
  SELECT o.id AS opportunity_id, o.name AS deal_name, c.id AS contact_id, c.first_name, c.email, c.unsubscribe_token
  FROM opportunities o
  JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
  WHERE o.status = 'Won' AND o.is_archived = false
    AND o.maintenance_interval_months IS NOT NULL
    AND c.is_archived = false AND c.do_not_contact = false AND c.dnc_email = false
    AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
    AND COALESCE(o.last_maintenance_followup_at, o.closed_at) <= now() - (o.maintenance_interval_months || ' months')::interval
)
SELECT d.* FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy(x) LEFT JOIN due d ON true;
